children: Precious metals are pulling back from the previous session's gains as a volatile oil market keeps alive concerns about inflation and higher interest rates. Investors remain cautious about the U.S. midterm elections, "which could have significant implications for energy policy and Washington's approach towards Iran," Kaynat Chainwala of Kotak Neo says in a note. "Further progress in U.S.-Iran negotiations could ease energy prices and support bullion, while renewed geopolitical tensions that keep crude oil elevated would reinforce inflation risks and leave gold and silver under pressure." Gold for December delivery is down 0.6% in New York at $3,946.80 a troy ounce. Silver is down 1.8% at $49.97 a troy ounce. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
